*CRITICAL — two merge blockers*

1. `src/validate.js:1–4` — The regex matches a substring, not the whole slug. Verified that `hello world`, `UPPERa`, `foo/bar`, and `"ok\n"` all pass validation and produce page URLs.
   *Fix:* Require a nonempty string containing *only* `[a-z0-9-]`, including rejecting trailing newlines. Add rejection tests through both `isValidSlug` and `pagePath`.

2. `src/route.js:4` — Reserved slugs are never checked. Verified that `new`, `edit`, `admin`, and `api` all produce page URLs despite the restriction documented in `README.md:13`; `src/reserved.js:3–4` is not wired into this path.
   *Fix:* Check `isReserved(slug)` before returning the page path, and add route tests asserting all four reserved names throw.

*INFORMATIONAL:* None.

All 4 existing tests pass. No code changed.
